text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (—A dream I had nurtured.)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(That dream always... keeps me running 
forward—)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Feels so good.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(At last, it begins...! My Twinkle 
Seriesâ)

text_block_list.name: Coach
text_block_list.text:
—Alright! Next group, take your marks! 
......Start!!

text_block_list.name: Young Bubble
text_block_list.text: Hah!!

text_block_list.name: Young Bubble
text_block_list.text: Yaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Club Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Kh, as expected of Bubble...! So fast...!

text_block_list.name: Young Bubble
text_block_list.text: —All right, first one here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Oooohh!)

text_block_list.name: Club Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Damn it! I won't lose next time, Bubble! 
Just you watch!

text_block_list.name: Young Bubble
text_block_list.text:
Haha, yeah! I'm gonna win the next one 
too!

text_block_list.name: Bubble's Father
text_block_list.text: —You seem to be in good shape, Bubble.

text_block_list.name: Young Bubble
text_block_list.text: Ah— Dad! Thanks for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Bubble's Father
text_block_list.text:
How about it, Bubble? How's training at 
the club?

text_block_list.name: Young Bubble
text_block_list.text:
It's fun! And everyone is so serious and 
passionate...!

text_block_list.name: Young Bubble
text_block_list.text:
"That's why it gets me so fired up...! It 
makes me want to become a strong Umamusume 
too...!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble's Father
text_block_list.text:
I see...! Well, that's a relief. I was a 
little worried about you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble's Father
text_block_list.text:
After all, Bubble is the daughter of my 
dad, who runs this club. ...Everyone would 
definitely be mindful of that.

text_block_list.name: Young Bubble
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be fine! I'll do my best to make Dad 
proud!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble's Father
text_block_list.text:
Bubble... ...You're already an Umamusume 
I'm proud of.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(...The club team Dad runs gave me so many 
things.)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(The fun of racing. The burning passion. 
The severity of aiming for the top. And—)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "—We're finally here. Tracen Academy...!"

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: It begins here. Our battle.

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
"For that reason, first of all, all four 
of us have to make our debuts together."

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
We can do it, totally! We're the 
unbeatable 'Four Heavenly Kings' who stick 
together forever! —Right, Bubble-chan!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
This is a declaration. That the four of 
us, the "Four Heavenly Kings"—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Let us stir up a whirlwind in this racing 
world. And blaze a trail forward!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
A world where the future of everyone in 
the club—and all Umamusume—shines 
brightly!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(The pledge with my best friends, who have 
been with me since our club days...—)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Ah, it's all bursting out now...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(All the feelings built up until today are 
swelling in my chest...! My spirit is 
soaring...!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...I will become one. Absolutely.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
To become a powerful Umamusume who can 
turn the racing world upside down—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Our days of taking on the Twinkle Series 
alongside Bubble Gum Fellow are about to 
truly begin starting today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To ensure we could start training in 
optimal condition, I was preparing in the 
trainers' break room when—

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Yo, good work! Training starts today, 
right? I know it'll be tough, but hang in 
there.
choice_data_list: Having a rough time?

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Haven't you heard? Apparently all of those 
"Four Heavenly Kings" might debut in the 
exact same year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—My trainee, Bubble Gum Fellow, hailed 
from a prominent club team and was an 
Umamusume whose future showed great 
promise from early on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And at that club, alongside Bubble Gum 
Fellow, there were three other Umamusume 
with equally high expectations for the 
future."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Due to their exceptional talent, the 
girls—including Bubble Gum Fellow— were 
hailed as the "Four Heavenly Kings," and 
all of them are currently enrolled at 
Tracen Academy—

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
—If all "Four Heavenly Kings" are from the 
same class, then attention on their 
generation will definitely skyrocket.

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
People are going to compare you to others, 
and the pressure will be intense. 
...That's what I meant by 'tough.'
choice_data_list:
Thanks for worrying about me. But I'm 
okay.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I have a dream that I've been cultivating 
together with Bubble Gum Fellow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A grand dream of causing an "explosion" 
that will turn the racing world on its 
head.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—After crossing paths with Bubble Gum 
Fellow, I made a vow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter what hardships await, do not 
fear, do not hesitate—let your dreams 
soar.

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, looks like you're raring to go! 
Guess I had nothing to worry about."

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Good luck. As your classmate, I'm rooting 
for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, upon arriving at the track 
where Bubble Gum Fellow was waiting—

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Bubble-senpai, your debut date is set, 
right?! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! Though having said that, it's 
still quite a ways off.

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"I'm always cheering for you, Senpai...! 
Please let me come watch your debut race 
too!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that makes me so happy! I'll 
definitely live up to those expectations.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Bubble Gum Fellow seemed to be 
surrounded by academy Umamusume for some 
reason.
choice_data_list:
(She's drawing attention from the other 
students too.)

(She's drawing attention from the other 
students too.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In other words, that equates to many 
people placing high hopes on Bubble Gum 
Fellow's future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As her dedicated trainer, I need to make 
sure I'm someone worthy who won't betray 
those expectations... Time to get fired 
up!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Ah— Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“—You're here. Everything's all set on my 
end!”
choice_data_list:
Yeah, sorry to keep you waiting. Let's get 
right to it!

Yeah, sorry to keep you waiting. Let's get 
started right away!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
choice_data_list: ...Something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Nope! It looked like you were bursting 
with energy over there too, and I thought 
it was nice."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: So, what should we start with?
choice_data_list:
First, let's do a light run on dirt. After 
that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And from there, the first day of 
training proceeded smoothly without a 
hitch—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Phew...! Worked up a good sweat~...!
choice_data_list: Good work!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
How was it? What did you think of how I 
did on my first day?
choice_data_list:
...Once again, I was reminded of how 
amazing your running is.

...Once again, I was reminded of how 
incredible your running is.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: “—Haaah!!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As always, Bubble Gum Fellow's running was 
sharp and refined, hardly resembling that 
of a pre-debut Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how capable she already is, I can't 
wait to see how much further she'll grow 
from here...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Fufu, I see! So it got you all excited.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Then at this rate, starting tomorrow...— 
*haaah*...—
choice_data_list: Huh, Bubble!?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry... I went all out in training 
today, so... maybe I just lost my 
focus...?
choice_data_list: A-Are you okay?
A-Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm fine... If I just chew some gum, 
this will pass in no—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? ...No way. Don't tell me—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I messed up...! I'm all out of 
gum...--

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I was so hyped up early this morning... 
that I completely misjudged how much I 
could chew...!"
choice_data_list:
So this is what happens when you run out 
of gum...?

So this is what happens when you run out 
of gum...?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Come to think of it... I hadn't 
told you...—
choice_data_list: Then this...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I handed Bubble Gum Fellow some gum that 
I happened to have with me today.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why do you have it, Trainer...? Wait, 
this is... the kind I always chew on...!
choice_data_list:
Because of your influence, I've been 
chewing on it sometimes lately...

Because of your influence, I've been 
stumbling over my words lately...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Really...! Thank you! Then I won't hold 
back—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Man, you really saved my bacon...! I feel 
totally refreshed thanks to you. I'm all 
good now!
choice_data_list: You really do love gum, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Part of it is that I just like it, but... 
Well, I guess it's also kind of like an 
old good luck charm.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It's about something from when I was a 
kid, but—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
In my first inter-club race tournament, 
I... got a little bit nervous. And then, 
Mom—

text_block_list.name: Bubble's Mother
text_block_list.text:
“—You see, this gum is packed with 'can-do 
power.'”

text_block_list.name: Young Bubble
text_block_list.text: "'I-can-do-it power'...?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Yes! The more you chew, the stronger your 
'can-do power' inside becomes, and you'll 
be able to do anything!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, give it a try. Think to yourself 
as you chew: I can do it, I can do it."

text_block_list.name: Young Bubble
text_block_list.text:
"Got it, I'll try! ...*chew*... 
*munch*...—"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—Across the line! Taking first place is 
Bubble Gum Fellow!"

text_block_list.name: Young Bubble
text_block_list.text:
"Amazing...! I ran better than usual...! I 
really, truly "did it"...!!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Ever since then, she started chewing 
gum before races, and that was only the 
beginning—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Gradually, whenever it was time to say 
'Let's do this!', she started biting down 
every single time...—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I ended up losing my 
strength if I didn't chew on it, you know?
choice_data_list: I see...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but today was kind of an exception! 
Since I was even more motivated than 
usual, the backlash from running out of 
gum was huge.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Well, whatever the case, I'll make sure 
I don't run out of gum next time.
choice_data_list:
I'll start carrying gum around with me 
from now on too.

I'll start carrying gum with me from now 
on too.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really? Honestly, that's a huge help. 
That's my Trainer for you!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...Since you're such a reliable Trainer, 
maybe I'll just go ahead and ask."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
A concrete goal for what we should aim for 
going forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Naturally, that was already decided 
within myself before being asked.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow and I share the same 
goal: to achieve 'unprecedented strength' 
that will turn the racing world upside 
down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In order to pioneer an 'unprecedented 
strength,' you must first prove your 
strength under existing values in a way 
that is undeniable to all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, the race we should aim for with 
her next is—
choice_data_list: Let's run in the Classic races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A battlefield steeped in tradition and 
glory, where Classic-class Umamusume can 
run only once in their lives. That is the 
Classic race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Led by the pinnacle of Umamusume 
festivals, the Japan Derby, many race fans 
turn their eyes here—the birthplace of 
Umamusume who define their eras—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, the Classic races— especially the 
Japan Derby... are considered one of the 
ultimate stages by traditional standards, 
aren't they?"
choice_data_list:
Prove yourself there, and let it lead to 
newfound strength!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
A bit like 'Shuhari,' I suppose. Fufu, 
talk about dreaming big before your debut!
choice_data_list: ...Did you get cold feet?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"No way! You're asking even though you 
know, right? —Naturally, it's the exact 
opposite!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Let's aim for the Classic races. I'm 
bursting with energy now...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bumping fists together, they fearlessly 
pledge towards their grand goal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our days of taking on challenges 
together with Bubble Gum Fellow had begun!
